author: OpenAI native image generation in ChatGPT, commissioned by user
usage_basis: Native AI-generated original from the user text brief; no external image, logo, branded chess design or third-party asset used. Intended use in the user project picross. No separate third-party license claimed.

actual_request.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: detailed full-color completion/reveal illustration for a curated nonogram game, first art selection stage, not a puzzle diagram. Create exactly ONE square, beautifully finished illustration of a single chess knight piece (horse-head chess figure), entirely visible from ear tips to circular stepped pedestal. Warm, calm, hand-drawn 2D illustration, confident clean dark-brown contours, strong coherent matte color areas, carefully developed interior drawing and restrained flat shading. Clear characteristic horse-head profile, ear, eye, muzzle, shaped mane, arched neck attached to a turned chess-piece base. Isolated on a quiet plain warm ivory background with a modest flat grounding shadow. Motif fills most of image, comfortably uncropped. It is an inanimate sculpted chess piece, not a live horse, no legs, no rider. Detailed rather than a plain silhouette; details support sculpted material and recognition. NO grid, cells, hints, numbers, text, watermark, collage, panel borders, chessboard or additional objects. NO photorealism, NO 3D render, NO painterly scratch noise. Later monochrome abstraction must be feasible, but DO NOT simplify to pixel art or abstraction now. Variant A: classic honey-gold carved boxwood Staunton-style knight in pure side profile facing left. Compact strong silhouette, gently lowered broad muzzle, a clearly cut ear, large clean recessed eye, a few gracefully curved carved mane grooves, warm amber shadows and ochre body planes, subtle broad wood-grain lines. Turned pedestal with two clear rounded tiers. Friendly dignified presence.

operations: Byte-identical copy of generated PNG; no crop, resize, recolor or retouch.
